audit_items.proof_trace: The clamping logic count.max(validator_custody_requirement).min(number_of_custody_groups) assumes validator_custody_requirement <= number_of_custody_groups. When this config invariant is violated (e.g., VCR=200, NCG=128), the function returns NCG (128), which is below the required minimum VCR (200), violating the lower bound. Config validation (config.rs:853) only checks config_name format and does not enforce this parameter relationship.
audit_items.attack_scenario: Malicious or misconfigured config file sets validator_custody_requirement > number_of_custody_groups. Function returns number_of_custody_groups, allowing validators to custody fewer groups than spec-required minimum, potentially compromising data availability guarantees when validators operate with insufficient custody coverage.
